tools.name: sandbox_create
tools.description: Creates an isolated spendctl sandbox: a real spendctl sidecar with a throwaway wallet, mock paid APIs and a mock facilitator. No real money moves and nothing outside the sandbox is reachable. Returns the sandbox_id to pass to the other tools, the agent's spending policy and the paid endpoints that e

tools.name: sandbox_pay
tools.description: Fetches one of the sandbox's paid endpoints (HTTP 402, x402) through the spendctl sidecar: https://weather.sandbox.spendctl.dev/weather?city=<name> ($0.01) or https://search.sandbox.spendctl.dev/search?q=<query> ($0.02), as listed by sandbox_create and documented at https://spendctl.dev/docs/sandbox

tools.name: check_budget
tools.description: Shows the sandbox agent's spending limits, what has been spent in each window, and what is left.

tools.name: list_receipts
tools.description: Lists the sandbox agent's recent payment attempts (paid, refused, waiting for approval) with amounts, reasons and mock transaction hashes.

tools.name: get_policy
tools.description: Returns the sandbox's spendctl.yaml: the agent's budgets, allowed hosts and approval rules.

tools.name: approve
tools.description: Decides a pending approval in this sandbox, as the human approver would with `spendctl approve`. An approved payment completes when sandbox_pay is called again with the same approvalId; a denied one stays refused.
